title: Japanese Cheesy Lasagna Roll-Ups
description: A creative twist on traditional lasagna, this Japanese-inspired dish combines rich, creamy cheese with the comforting familiarity of a Canadian classic.
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a medium saucepan, heat teriyaki sauce over low heat.
Combine cheese blend and ricotta cheese in a bowl.
Spread a layer of the cheese mixture on each lasagna sheet.
Drizzle teriyaki sauce over the cheese mixture.
Roll up the lasagna sheets tightly and place seam-side down in a baking dish.
Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes.
Garnish with chopped green onions before serving.
Let rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
